text.en: 1. This Act may be cited as the Loan Guarantee Act, 1972. Short title.

2. (1) The following provisions of thé Loans (Asian Penga
Development Bank) Act, 1968, namely—                  applying
(a) section 7 (which authorises the Government to give '*'****
guarantees and undertakings with respect to
borrowings by statutory authorities from the Asian
Development Bank); and

(b) so far as they relate to guarantees and undertakings
by the Government, section 11 and section 12
(which contain supplementary provisions for the
implementation, among other. things, of any such
guarantee or undertaking), save that for the words
"1950" in subsection (5) of section 12, there shall
be substituted therefor the words "1960";

shall apply in relation to any borrowing from that Bank
by the. company called Malaysian Industrial Development
Finance Limited as if the company were a statutory
authority within the meaning of that Act, and the borrowing
were made under subsection (1) of section 5 of that Act.

(2) If any sum is paid out of the Consolidated Fund in
respect of any liability incurred by the Government by
virtue of subsection (1), the Minister shall as soon as possible
beginning with the sitting of the House of Representatives
immediately after any such sum was paid and ending with
that in which all liability in respect thereof and any interest
payable thereon is finally discharged by the company, lay
before the House of Representatives at each of its sittings
a Statement relating thereto.

(3) Subsection (2) (a) and (b) of the said section 12 (which
provides for exemptions from taxation and from exchange
control) shall also apply in relation to any agreement
concluded, whether before or after the passing of this Act,
with the Bank by the company, with the approval of the
Government, in respect of any borrowing by the company
from the Bank, and to any bond, promissory note or
instrument issued by the company pursuant to any such
agreement, as they apply to the agreements and instruments
there mentioned.

3, The agreement of guarantee heretofore concluded
between the Government in the name of the Federation
and the Bank is hereby ratified and validated in all respects
and shall have effect for all purposes as if the provisions
of this Act had been in force on such date and the said
agreement had been duly concluded and executed in
exercise of the powers conferred by or under this Act.

4, If a resolution be passed by the House of Representatives
that the provisions of section 2 of this Act shall apply to
any company, as they apply to the Malaysian Industrial
Development Finance Limited, then the Minister may, by
Order published in the Gazette, declare that the said
provisions of the Act shall apply to that company.

KUALA LUMPUR
DI-CHETAK OLEH PENCHETAK KERAJAAN DAN DI-TERBITKAN DENGAN PERENTAH PADA
29HB FEBRUARI, 1972
